_comment: Row 282. The regression removes the unique cwd transition from bd-opv's owned resource boundary. The real OPV-HEALTH fixture instruments Python file opens and SQLite connects, proves the application boot ran, and rejects the resulting app_config/log writes in the caller's operator directory. Run from a detached scratch repository with: venv/bin/python toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row_282_bd_opv_resource_boundary.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH. The companion row_282_bd_opv_resource_boundary_transform_control.json applies the identical valid transform to an import-only test and must ESCAPE.
subject: Row 282 -- bd-opv confines cwd-relative config and log writers to its owned resource root

mutants.label: M1 verifier checks run from the operator cwd instead of the owned cwd
